records.scope_note: Specific PBS blend with 45 wt.% softwood kraft lignin Indulin AT relative to total polymer mass; source B45 simple-blend series, not DCP-reactive R45. Section 2.3 describes separately extruded physical formulations, and Table 6 reports the separately measured B45 tensile result. The 45 wt.% lignin formulation differs from the existing B10, B20 and B30 compositions; processing states, test repeats and translated labels do not create additional identities. Broad composite category denotes lignin-filled polymer, not an engineered continuous-fiber laminate. Section 2.1 gives the unresolved combined designation BioPBS FZ91PM/FZ91PB; no single grade is selected or inferred. Bxx/Rxx are study formulation labels, not certified grades. Catalog-only source reference; not a universal material constant, automatic calculator input or engineering allowable.
